name: Lessons
description: Learn a note, a PR or a topic one step at a time, answering as you go, then keep it with cards that come back just before you'd forget.
author: Vaultite
forAgents: To teach the user something (a note, a PR, a topic): a lesson, plus cards for what's worth remembering (`vau docs lessons`). To quiz them: `cards.due`.

lessons.description: lessons in progress, cards files and the cards to review now

retention.label: Target recall
retention.description: how likely you should be to remember a card when it comes back: higher means more reviews

new_per_day.label: New cards a day
new_per_day.description: how many cards you haven't seen a day's reviews bring in

remind_at.label: Remind at
remind_at.description: when the day's reminder comes to your Inbox (and phone) if cards are due and you've reviewed cards before, HH:MM; empty for none. One at a time: it goes once you've reviewed them
